description_en: Updates the VPC private network access whitelist of a specified instance
description_zh: 更新指定实例的VPC私网访问白名单
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch update-private-network-white-ips --instance-id es-cn-tl329rbpc00010000 --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --modify-mode Cover --biz-body example-string --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePrivateNetworkWhiteIps

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The modification mode. Valid values:

Cover (default): overwrites the original IP whitelist with the value of the ips parameter.

Append: adds the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter to the original IP whitelist.

Delete: removes the IP addresses specified in the ips parameter from the original IP whitelist. At least one IP address must be retained
parameters.help_zh:
修改方式，取值含义如下：

Cover（默认值）：使用ips参数的值覆盖原IP白名单。

Append：在原IP白名单中增加ips参数中输入的IP地址。

Delete：在原IP白名单中删除ips参数中输入的IP地址，至少需要保留一个IP地址
parameters.name: modify_mode
